hardware_profile.name: adaptive
hardware_profile.selection_reason: start at logical/physical batch 256 with no query chunking; after OOM use 128/64/32 physical micro-batches with accumulation, then halve the all-pairs query chunk from all when the 32-sample tier still cannot fit

rating_policy.l1_primary_delta: strictly positive held-out primary metric versus disabled baseline
rating_policy.quantum_inspired_relative_gain: classical counterpart must exceed 1% relative gain versus disabled baseline

metadata.mechanism: frozen group leave-one-out counterfactual influence over projected support

cost_model.group_intervention: all active members of one declared group are masked together
cost_model.group_manifest: frozen_label_free positional blocks unless explicitly supplied; random control uses a separately frozen seeded manifest with the same group sizes

per_head_constructor.mechanism: predeclared label-free group removal of projected support, size-normalized group action score, and member distribution

numerical_stability.zero_norm_key_behavior: zero normalized member probe and finite zero contribution

per_head_constructor.quantum_resource_note: Exact statevector simulation establishes functional behavior only; it does not establish hardware speedup or quantum advantage.
